nodes.description: Package labels and signed component costs, in original order.
Maximum number of labels to return; nonpositive means return none.

Input packages contains (label, component_costs). Output scored contains (total_cost, label) for each package in original order; total_cost is the sum of its signed costs, zero for an empty cost list. Preserve duplicate labels and never mutate input. O(total number of costs) time.

Input scored contains (total_cost, label), never (index, total_cost). Stably sort by total_cost ascending, preserving original order on ties. Return labels only, at most max(0, limit) entries, or all if fewer exist. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate scored. O(n log n) time.
